description: Update the cargo-shuttle tool to simplify how it determines the local project name, particularly when running in non-cargo workspaces or when the `--id` or `--name` flags are provided. The new logic should avoid errors by not assuming a cargo workspace must exist and by removing dependency on Shuttle.toml for local name resolution. Refactor the CLI integration tests to use assert_cmd and process to eliminate side effects like setting a global API key.
functional_requirements: Implement a new fallback sequence for resolving the local project name: first use the workspace root package name if it exists, else use the name of the cargo workspace root directory, else use the name of the working directory.
Remove the previous logic that resolved the local name from Shuttle.toml and assumed a cargo workspace must exist, ensuring commands work correctly in non-cargo workspaces.
Fix metadata errors in project-related commands (e.g., run, build) when the `--id` or `--name` flags are provided, ensuring they function without errors.
Refactor all CLI integration tests to use assert_cmd and process for command execution, eliminating any side effects such as setting a global API key during test runs.
